title: Returns
intro: How returns and refunds are meant to work.

p: Each product has its own return policy. By default you can return a product within 7 days after delivery.
Electrical parts that have been opened or installed cannot be returned, unless they are faulty.
You open a return request with photos. If it is approved, you send the product back.
Refunds go back to the original payment method, or as a credit note.
